description: Resolve current DNS records for a domain — A, AAAA, MX, NS, SOA, TXT, CNAME, PTR, SRV, CAA, DS, DNSKEY, or `all`. Use this whenever you need today's authoritative answer for any record type. Do NOT use this for historical resolution data (use `dns_history`), to enumerate domains pointing at an IP (use `reverse_ip`), or to search records by pattern across the zone (use `reverse_dns`).

query_type.description: Comma-separated DNS query types (A, MX, NS, SOA, etc.) or "all".

name: dns_lookup
